title: Accounting and Tax Services for Nurses

rows.before: We incorporated her Nursing Professional Corporation, moved the practice in on a section 85 rollover, and taxed active income at 12.2% on the first $500,000 under the section 125 small business deduction.
rows.after: We incorporated her Nursing Professional Corporation, moved the practice in on a section 85 rollover, and taxed active income at 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) on the first $500,000 under the section 125 small business deduction.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

page_note: All 12.2% occurrences are in case-study cards; no JSON-LD, meta or calculator occurrences. No 3.2%, 0.122, 0.032 or $600K found.
